versions.changelog: 0.4: English interface (German stays available), SubtitleForge entry in Jellyfin's "⋮" menu and for multi-select, delete single subtitles the plugin made, every plugin subtitle is marked "[SF]" (older files are renamed once), live style preview, batch actions in the overview, OCR for DVD (VobSub) subtitles, Docker example with Vulkan. Security hardening: signed download ids, https-only host allowlists and size limits for downloads, zip bomb and image-subtitle memory limits, safe file names from container language tags, atomic temp files, hardened parsers.

0.3: Untertitel-Button auf der Seite von Film/Folge/Staffel/Serie, ganze Staffeln/Serien auf einmal, Vorschau mit "passt nicht", Statistik, Sync-Bericht für die ganze Bibliothek, Pause während der Wiedergabe, Zeitfenster, Zusammenfassung im Aktivitätsprotokoll/Webhook, Whisper als letzter Ausweg nach X Tagen, GPU-Selbsttest, ASS→SRT, Forced-Untertitel für Synchronfassungen, Quelle Jimaku, Forced-Erkennung bei mehreren OCR-Spuren.

name: SubtitleForge
overview: Uniform subtitle style, OCR for image subtitles, verified downloads, sync fixing, offline translation, Whisper
description: One subtitle style for the whole server, OCR for Blu-ray and DVD image subtitles, downloads (SubDL, OpenSubtitles, Jimaku) checked against the audio, sync fixing, offline translation and Whisper speech recognition (CPU or GPU via Vulkan). English and German interface.
